text:
marta.g: Heads up — after the RBAC refactor deploy we're seeing projects from org-456 surface under org-123 in the metadata pipeline. tagging @samir @alex.k for visibility.

samir: Ugh, can you paste an example request/response?

marta.g: sure — from PROD logs:```
req_id=01Fabc user_id=u-993 x-org=org-123 x-workspace=proj-789 target_org=org-456 model=stable
response: 200 OK payload.owner_org=org-456 payload.projects=[proj-789]
```

alex.k: quick read — looks like the role-id normalizer we merged yesterday removes the org prefix when role aliases map to common IDs. role IDs became global-scoped instead of org-scoped.

joyce.s: that would explain why the permission check allowed cross-org metadata reads. also seeing KMS decrypt failures for a subset of keys — maybe KMS bindings were tied to org-scoped service accounts that no longer match. error: `AccessDeniedException: kms:Decrypt denied for key alias/tenant-456`

samir: adding context — migration script `rbac/normalize_role_ids.v2` ran on 2799987000, single-step. It replaced `org-<id>#role:<name>` with `role:<name>` everywhere.

marta.g: exact. We need to pause the rest of the rollout and revert the normalizer. Can someone trigger rollback and flag the DB writes for manual review? :warning:

infra-bot: rollback job `rbac-normalizer-v2` queued by @alex.k — ETA ~4m.

alex.k: reverting the code now and starting a hotfix to reintroduce org scoping in the role map. will run a DB reconciliation to rehydrate scoped_role_id where possible. running `SELECT count(*) FROM role_map WHERE scoped_role_id IS NULL;`

joyce.s: on the KMS side, I'll open a ticket with KMS team and rotate the affected key bindings for tenant 456. meanwhile adding an audit flag to capture decrypt failures to the security SQS.

samir: creating incident SEC-2029, severity P2 for now until rollback completes. I'll capture timeline and affected customers.

marta.g: FYI — quick mitigation: enforce org header check in the permission gateway for any read that includes a workspace/org mismatch. Patch applied to canary.

alex.k: DB reconciliation script started, will output a list of altered rows to `s3://redwood-security/incident/2799990000/recon.csv`.

infra-bot: rollback job `rbac-normalizer-v2` completed successfully at 2799990065.

samir: checks: authz gateway canary shows no cross-org reads for the past 2m. good sign.

joyce.s: KMS ticket opened #KMS-1248, temporarily re-bound tenant-456 service account to key alias/tenant-456 for emergency reads. will coordinate key rotation with customer ops. :lock:

marta.g: good. next steps: (1) full DB audit of role_map (2) restore org-scoping in normalizer and add comprehensive unit tests (3) replay audit logs to verify no historical exfiltration (4) customer outreach draft. assigning owners in the incident doc.

alex.k: note for postmortem — add a migration safety gate that refuses global-id normalization when `scoped_role_id` exists and audit mode isn't set.

samir: will update SEC-2029 with timeline and affected customer list once recon.csv is ready.

marta.g: thanks all. please keep thread updates concise. we'll do a full postmortem after containment. :white_check_mark:
